evidence.title: Sponsored: Can today’s fiber infrastructure planning keep pace with tomorrow’s AI workload demands?

summary: As AI models expand in size and compute intensity, they demand massive data transfers that strain current fiber‑optic networks. Industry analysts warn that without accelerated planning and upgrades, today’s fiber infrastructure may fall behind the bandwidth needs of tomorrow’s AI workloads.
title: Experts Question Whether Existing Fiber Networks Can Meet Future AI Data Demands
